recognize_zh: 腎臟切片中腎小管被大量間質內的小型淋巴樣細胞分隔撐開，小管上皮變扁平、部分管腔內有管柱與脫落物，顯示腎小管損傷；此倍率看不到腎絲球或明確濾泡結構，淋巴瘤診斷需靠免疫染色（CD20、CD10、BCL2）確認。
features: Core biopsy fragment with tubules widely separated by a dense interstitial cellular infiltrate
Infiltrate composed predominantly of small, monotonous round to slightly irregular lymphoid cells
Tubular injury: flattened or simplified epithelium, dilated lumens and intraluminal casts/debris
No glomeruli and no distinct nodular or follicular architecture identified at this power
Loose, edematous interstitial stroma between infiltrate and tubules
describe_en: Renal core biopsy sections show limited renal parenchyma composed of tubules separated by a dense, diffuse interstitial infiltrate of small monotonous lymphoid cells. The tubules show acute injury with epithelial flattening, luminal dilatation and scattered intraluminal casts. Glomeruli are not present in this field and a follicular pattern is not appreciable at this magnification. The findings represent an interstitial lymphoid process; immunohistochemistry demonstrating a CD20+/CD10+/BCL2+ B-cell population is required to establish renal involvement by follicular lymphoma and to exclude reactive interstitial nephritis.

ddx.vs: Interstitial nephritis contains a mixed infiltrate with eosinophils, neutrophils, plasma cells and tubulitis, whereas lymphoma is a monotonous B-cell infiltrate that expands the interstitium.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma involving kidney
ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is CD5+/CD23+/CD10- and may show proliferation centers, requiring immunostains to separate from follicular lymphoma.
IgG4-related disease has storiform fibrosis and abundant IgG4+ plasma cells rather than a monotonous small B-cell infiltrate.
MZL cells are CD10-/BCL6- with monocytoid or plasmacytoid features, distinguished from FL by immunohistochemistry.
